text: The meeting identified scope/goal misalignment where participants misunderstood the project goal and product.
A written plan covering functional and technical design, staffing, timeframe, budget, and market plan is due in two weeks.
There is no written project plan or budget yet, and essential documentation is missing to present to management.

The team will identify additional contributors from marketing, technical, and administration and inform the PM; UI will build the overall plan incorporating inputs from usability, marketing, and design groups.
The project focus will be on designing a remote control for television as the first product, and the team will deliver the project plan in two weeks.
